notes.title: New Demo Out!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!
Temple of Revi has now a new demo with a lot of interesting new Levels! on this new demo you will find stages from the second world, the Winter scenario, Frost Grove!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44028195/1f37f40f14471f8fcdef4ccc5508f8b0ac154f66.gif[/img]

Also, the demo page is now separate from the main steam page, which means you can write a review about the demo! It would help a lot if you guys could write us review to helps us to know what you think so we can improve the game even more for the full release!

notes.title: New Level on Demo version
notes.content:
Hey, guys! We have a new level on the demo of the game! It was supposed to be released with the other levels, but we had to made some adjustments first, so we decided to wait and add it later. But now you can play it! 

You just need to play the 7th level again to unlock the new level (sorry, I couldn't find a way to make it easier for those who already completed all the levels (-_-" )).
